verdict.rationale: Angular's docs present components as its core building block ([angular-docs-2]) and Signals for fine-grained reactive state ([angular-docs-1]). Community users corroborate that components are encapsulated and truly reusable ([angular-comm-2]) and compose through @Input/@Output ([angular-comm-1]). AngularJS-era complaints about its directives API are about the older framework and do not contradict this. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of component-local state management and composition patterns (the evidence is mostly marketing taglines), and recent hands-on corroboration for current Angular.
